name: Writing tool inside an existing Electron + Capacitor browser
user_idea: I have an existing Electron + Capacitor browser app called tinker. The repo has src/main/ (Electron main process, IPC) and src/renderer/ (the chrome — sidebar with tabs, address bar, welcome page, plain HTML/CSS/JS). I want to add a writing surface inside this existing shell: each writing session is a tab in the sidebar; the welcome page becomes a feed of others' essays with a 'Start writing' entry point at the top; clicking the entry point opens a guided writing flow where Claude asks questions and stitches the user's typed answers into prose using only the user's own words.
platform_target: All of the above from one codebase, web-first

phase1.q1_relief_moment: The user finishes their writing flow, hits publish, looks at the URL of their essay and recognizes themselves on the page — every sentence is theirs, just rearranged. They paste the link into Twitter.
phase1.q2_yesterday: They drafted in Notion (no audience), then chatted with ChatGPT (got back AI-shaped prose), then hand-edited the AI prose into their own voice for two hours, then posted on LinkedIn.
phase1.q3_one_tiny_thing: Type answers to Claude's adaptive questions; Claude stitches them into prose that lives at a unique URL.
phase1.q4_input_output: Input: the user's typed answers to Claude's questions. Output: a unique URL pointing at the stitched essay.
phase1.q5_the_line: No AI-written sentences. No AI-generated images. No comments or likes in v1. No web search.

phase2.q2_followup_specific_shape: An onboarding flow — one question at a time, full focus, big input, progress indicator, paginated, like Typeform or Stripe's setup. NOT a chat with text area at the bottom.
phase2.q3_first_time: Someone else's work, beautifully — a feed of others' essays seeded so day one isn't blank, with a 'Start writing' entry point at the top.
q4_brings_back: They have unfinished work in here
Something changed while they were gone
phase2.q5_hardest_moment: At the empty state — they don't know what to put in
phase2.q7_visual_canon: The existing app I already have
